prompts.q: Name a type of aphasia: the 8 classic types or 3 primary progressive variants
prompts.note: The classic Wernicke-Lichtheim aphasias and the three primary progressive variants.

prompts.q: Name a cartilage of the larynx
prompts.note: The cartilages of the larynx: what every hello is built on.

spare.q: Name one of the 12 OECD countries with the most hospital beds per person (Health at a Glance 2025)
spare.note: OECD Health Statistics 2025, hospital beds per 1,000 people, 2023 or nearest year, OECD members only.

prompts.q: Name a structure derived from the cartilage of the pharyngeal arches
prompts.note: Skeletal derivatives of arches 1 to 6, where the 22q11.2 story starts: 1st (Meckel's), 2nd (Reichert's), 3rd, and 4th/6th.

prompts.q: Name a structure derived from the pharyngeal pouches
prompts.note: Endoderm of pouches 1 to 4, as embryology teaches it. Pouches 3 and 4 are the 22q11.2 story: thymus and parathyroids.

prompts.q: Name one of the 15 countries with the highest under-five mortality rate (UN IGME/World Bank, 2023)
prompts.note: World Bank data from UN IGME, deaths per 1,000 live births, 2023.

spare.q: Name a layer of the epidermis
spare.note: The five strata, deep to surface. The stratum lucidum only turns up in thick skin.

prompts.q: Name a body region in the Wallace rule of nines for adult burns
prompts.note: Wallace rule of nines: 11 lots of 9% plus 1%, the maths of burns. Each arm is one lot, and each leg has a front and a back.

prompts.q: Name an SI base unit
prompts.note: The seven SI base units. Every drug dose and growth chart starts here.

prompts.q: Name a result reported on a standard full blood count
prompts.note: Standard automated full blood count with differential.

spare.q: Name an activity on the Katz ADL or Lawton IADL scale
spare.note: Katz (1963) six basic activities of daily living plus Lawton and Brody (1969) eight instrumental ones.

prompts.q: Name one of the 10 substance groups most often involved in young children's exposures reported to US poison centres (NPDS, 2024)
prompts.note: America's Poison Centers NPDS 2024, children 5 and under, % of substances. It reflects what children get into, not what is most toxic.

prompts.q: Name a pathogen in the ESKAPE group of drug-resistant bacteria
prompts.note: Rice, J Infect Dis 2008: six hospital pathogens that "escape" antibiotics, one for each letter.

prompts.q: Name one of the 10 highest-scoring life events on the Holmes and Rahe stress scale (1967)
prompts.note: Holmes and Rahe Social Readjustment Rating Scale, top 10 by life change units. Note that marriage scores 50.
a: Death of a close family member

spare.q: Name one of the 10 OECD countries with the most practising nurses per person (Health at a Glance 2025)
spare.note: OECD Health at a Glance 2025, Table 1.6, practising nurses per 1,000 people, latest year, mostly 2023.

prompts.q: Name one of the 20 standard amino acids
prompts.note: The 20 proteinogenic amino acids in the standard genetic code.

prompts.q: Name one of the 20 drugs ranked for overall harm by Nutt, King and Phillips (Lancet, 2010)
prompts.note: Independent Scientific Committee on Drugs, UK multicriteria decision analysis: combined harm to users and to others, out of 100. Harm ranking, not a guide to anything else.

prompts.q: Name a dental specialty recognised by the American Dental Association
prompts.note: ADA National Commission on Recognition of Dental Specialties: 12 specialties.

prompts.q: Name one of the 10 countries where women have the longest life expectancy (UN World Population Prospects 2024)
prompts.note: UN WPP 2024, female life expectancy at birth, 2026 estimate, sovereign states.

prompts.q: Name an antidote on the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines (2023)
prompts.note: WHO EML 23rd list (2023), section 4, antidotes and other substances used in poisonings. Antivenoms sit in a separate section.

spare.q: Name one of the 10 OECD countries with the highest daily smoking rate (Health at a Glance 2025)
spare.note: OECD Health at a Glance 2025, daily smokers aged 15+, latest year, mostly 2023.

prompts.q: Name a phase of the normal gait cycle (Rancho Los Amigos)
prompts.note: The eight Rancho Los Amigos phases of walking: five in stance and three in swing, the physiotherapist's view of active travel.

prompts.q: Name one of the 10 OECD countries with the highest adult obesity rate (Health at a Glance 2025)
prompts.note: OECD Health at a Glance 2025, obesity at age 15+, latest year, mostly 2023. Mexico, New Zealand and Latvia are measured; the rest self-reported.

prompts.q: Name a pollutant in the WHO global air quality guidelines (2021)
prompts.note: The classical pollutants with guideline levels in the 2021 WHO air quality guidelines, much of it from traffic.

spare.q: Name one of the 12 countries with the highest road death rate (WHO estimates, 2019)
spare.note: WHO estimates for 2019 via Wikipedia's table, deaths per 100,000 people. Most of the world's road deaths happen in low- and middle-income countries.

prompts.q: Name a winner of the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine from 2016 to 2025
prompts.note: All 22 laureates for 2016-2025, from autophagy (Ohsumi) to peripheral immune tolerance (Brunkow, Ramsdell, Sakaguchi).

prompts.q: Name a winner of the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine from 1961 to 1969
prompts.note: All 23 laureates for 1961-1969, from the cochlea (von Békésy) and the DNA double helix to the genetic code and phage genetics.

prompts.q: Name one of the 10 OECD countries with the highest avoidable mortality rate (Health at a Glance 2025)
prompts.note: OECD Health at a Glance 2025, avoidable deaths per 100,000 people under 75, latest year, 2020-2023.

spare.q: Name one of Bradford Hill's nine criteria for causation (1965)
spare.note: Austin Bradford Hill, 'The Environment and Disease', Proc R Soc Med 1965.

prompts.q: Name one of the 10 countries with the most measles cases (CDC, March to August 2026)
prompts.note: CDC Global Measles Outbreaks, top 10, provisional monthly data reported to WHO, March to August 2026. A moving list, so this is a snapshot.

prompts.q: Name a response on the Glasgow Coma Scale
prompts.note: The 15-point scale: eye, verbal and motor responses. "No response" sits on all three lines, so it counts once.

prompts.q: Name a poison featured in Kathryn Harkup's 'A is for Arsenic: The Poisons of Agatha Christie'
prompts.note: Harkup (2015), 14 chapters, each paired with a Christie novel. Fiction and history only.

spare.q: Name one of the eight RCRA metals in US hazardous waste rules
spare.note: The eight metals with toxicity limits under 40 CFR 261.24, the US EPA hazardous waste rule.

prompts.q: Name a type of conjoined twins, by the site of union
prompts.note: The standard Spencer classification of conjoined twins (the suffix -pagus means fastened).

prompts.q: Name an adult remnant of the fetal circulation
prompts.note: What the five fetal shunts and vessels become after birth. The start of the umbilical arteries stays open as the superior vesical arteries.

prompts.q: Name one of the 10 oldest verified men ever (Wikipedia list, 11 October 2026)
prompts.note: Wikipedia 'List of the verified oldest people', 11 October 2026, based on longevity validators. Only Jiroemon Kimura has reached 116; João Marinho Neto was still living then.
a: List of the verified oldest people
prompts.src: List of the verified oldest people

spare.q: Name one of the 12 original 'dirty dozen' chemicals of the Stockholm Convention (2001)
spare.note: The 12 initial persistent organic pollutants, mostly organochlorine pesticides plus industrial chemicals and combustion by-products.

prompts.q: Name one of the Edinburgh Seven, the first women matriculated at a British university (1869)
prompts.note: Seven women who enrolled in medicine at the University of Edinburgh in 1869 and were barred from graduating there.

prompts.q: Name an endocrine gland
prompts.note: The classic glands of the endocrine system.

prompts.q: Name one of the 10 OECD countries that drink the most alcohol per person (Health at a Glance 2025)
prompts.note: OECD Health at a Glance 2025, litres per person aged 15+, sales data, 2023 or nearest. Scotland's minimum unit price arrived in 2018, for the record.

spare.q: Name one of the eight cities of Scotland
spare.note: The eight places with official city status. Lister developed antiseptic surgery in one and Ian Donald obstetric ultrasound in the same one.
